tfn.s: The article suggests that employers who claim to want independent thinkers may still reward conformity.

speak.title: Role-play: the iced coffee at the interview
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: A candidate has arrived for a formal interview with an iced coffee. You think it looks too relaxed. Explain your worry, ask two questions, then decide what happens.

b.text: You've brought an iced coffee because you're nervous and thirsty. You think it's unfair to judge you for a drink. Explain why, and suggest a solution.
